summary_en: This study tests Acoustic Cluster Therapy (ACT) with the drug PS101 and ultrasound, given together with modified FOLFIRINOX chemotherapy, for locally advanced pancreatic cancer. How the treatment is given, and how often or for how long, is not stated. The main outcome measure is not stated; this is a Phase 2 study.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa la Terapia Acústica por Racimos (ACT, por sus siglas en inglés) con el medicamento PS101 y ultrasonido, administrada junto con quimioterapia FOLFIRINOX modificada, para el cáncer de páncreas localmente avanzado. No se indica cómo se administra el tratamiento, ni con qué frecuencia o por cuánto tiempo. No se indica la medida de resultado principal; este es un estudio de Fase 2.
who_for: Not suitable for primary curative surgery, with inoperable locally advanced or borderline resectable pancreatic cancer
Considered suitable for mFOLFIRINOX by the investigator
not_for: Any prior anti-cancer treatment for pancreatic cancer, such as chemotherapy, surgery or radiation
